threshold_basis: Explicit engineering review policy. Occupied orthonormality, AO metric and density scales follow frozen ordinary-v1 checks. The new full-space equation and normalized residual limits are declared engineering choices, not a new scientific convergence/stability criterion. No original threshold is modified.
relative_residual_definition: ||Fw Cw - Cw diag(epsilon)||F / max(||Fw Cw||F, (1 hartree) ||Cw||F), Fw=S^(-1/2) F S^(-1/2), Cw=S^(1/2) C
normalization_note: Full C-dagger-S-C-I norm is absolute and dimensionless. Raw generalized eigen residual is in hartree; the whitened relative residual is dimensionless. All stated thresholds apply together. Sorting uses absolute hartree tolerance. No implicit numpy allclose relative tolerance.
